intro.text: An Alethi soldier, second son of General Khal and Teshav, and an accomplished vehah wrestler.

items.text: Raised largely by his father to respect his superiors without fearing them, Aratin often wrestled in a training room near the Kholin soldiers' quarters in Urithiru.

In early 1174 a restless Dalinar challenged him; Aratin warned he hadn't lost in months. He tripped Dalinar and pinned his face to the mat, and when Navani interrupted, Dalinar conceded. Aratin winced when a friend slapped his shoulder, and Dalinar realised he should have yielded sooner.

appearance.text: Lighteyed and at least in his mid-thirties, he is extremely muscular, with a head that looks almost too small for his body and a gap in his teeth.

personality.text: Capable of formal speech with high-ranking lighteyes, but happy to be informal when allowed, and unafraid of hurting Dalinar on the mat.
